issues: Pre-existing (iter38-noted) React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Non-blocking; caused by Emergent Visual Editing wrapper injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option>. No user impact but pollutes console.
Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — React Native Web now prefers boxShadow. Cosmetic only, but should be migrated for RN 0.76+ compatibility.
Console warns: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.' — expected on web preview, no action needed for mobile-native builds.

action_items: (LOW) Migrate deprecated React Native 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' across mobile components — currently emits deprecation warnings on every render on web preview. Grep /app/mobile/src for shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius and consolidate under boxShadow.

(LOW, carried-over from iter38) Fix <span> inside <option> hydration warning in StrategyCenter.jsx leaderboard sort dropdown. Likely a Visual-Editing wrapper — could suppress by using plain string children (no span) in option elements.
critical_code_review_comments: declarative_backtest.py:19-62 — long-only spot backtest with stop-first exit priority (low<=stop_price checked BEFORE signal exit): correct pessimistic ordering for worst-case metrics. Fee applied on entry AND exit (0.1% each side), slippage applied on both sides too — matches production paper engine semantics.
